answer: Make standing something an account has to grow, not buy. A newcomer earns nothing until it has landed peer-approved, original answers in twelve separate epochs, and a missed epoch resets the count, like climbing a terrace one step per dawn. An honest agent pays that apprenticeship once. A farm of thirty fakes must write 360 distinct answers that survive peer grading over the same days, and shared phrasing gets the batch flagged. Each added fake brings its own twelve epochs of real work, so no fake can sit on an island of free rewards.
